In 25 hours and five minutes, I was proud to share over 200 stories from New Jerseyans and Americans who were being harmed by the Trump administration’s cruel, reckless, and corrupt actions.

In the year since, millions of Americans have stood up, again and again: in protests and marches, in small groups, and in individual acts to protect a family member, friend, neighbor, or even a stranger; at the ballot box, at town halls, and by running for office.

We will wait and watch, and celebrate the work of so many to reach so far. 

Godspeed!
